thread:
alex (oncall): Heads-up — flight got cancelled, I won't make the midnight handoff. Need someone to take primary for 00:00-06:00 UTC tonight. I'm available to be secondary for handback at ~06:00 UTC if needed. Current notes: eu-embed-queue job runs at 01:30 UTC — recommend we avoid any config churn around that window. Also we have the nightly quantization deploy scheduled for 02:15 on dedicated pools; would prefer to postpone if we have to swap. Links to runbooks below.

maria: I can take 00:00-03:00 UTC. Happy to own pages. @jon can you pick up 03:00-06:00?

jon: I can take 03:00-06:00. Quick question — any active incidents or customer-facing pages right now?

incident-bot: [AUTO] Pager cleared: eu-embed-queue latency spike -> OK. Incident 2026-03-15-eu-latency moved from P1 to P3. Timeline: spike at 23:58 UTC, mitigated by cache warmup at 00:05 UTC. No open on-call tasks.

lina: Thanks. Can someone paste the minimal handoff checklist? Also need runbook link for the embed queue and the fallback model routing rules.

alex (oncall): Paste from checklist — keep it simple:
```
- Confirm primary/secondary names + contact
- Check incident board for open P0/P1
- Verify scheduled jobs in the next 6h (embeds/deploys)
- Confirm scheduled maintenance windows -> postpone if cover is reduced
- Share runbook links and escalation phone numbers
```
Runbooks: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/embeds-queue and https://internal.redwood/runbooks/oncall-handoff
Also, if you get a page for eu-embed-queue, escalate to the dedicated pool fallback after 2 failed retries: runbook step 4.

maria: Got it. I'll add the swap to the oncall calendar and set a short note in the team rota. @deploy-bot please hold tonight's quantization deploy if possible?

deploy-bot: Scheduling hold request submitted for job id: qc-20260315-02:15. Owner: alex. Status: pending approval from infra-sched.

jon: One more — alert routing: are we still routing EU latency pages to primary first then to dedicated? I don't want double paging.

alex (oncall): Yes — policy is primary -> dedicated fallback -> paging to oncall_secondary only if both fail. If you want to mute the dedicated fallback for a short window (to avoid noisy duplicates), annotate the incident channel and I can adjust the routing TTL.

maria: I'll take primary from 00:00-03:00, jon takes 03:00-06:00. Adding this to the oncall doc now. @sre-runbooks can you confirm the embed queue runbook version?

sre-runbooks: Confirmed runbook v2.1 (updated 2026-03-12). Fallback routing TTL defaults to 45s. Step summary: cache warmup -> prefix KV flush -> model variant fallback -> scale-up dedicated pool.

jon: Noted. If we get a page during the 01:30 embed job, try cache warmup first, then escalate per runbook. I'll be monitoring 02:00-06:00 window.

alex (oncall): Thanks all. Quick user-facing status to prepare if we escalate: "We're investigating slow response times for embeddings in EU, mitigation in progress; no data loss reported." Keep it short.

maria: Adding that template to the incident-prep folder. Also setting my phone escalation to on. :phone: 

jon: I'll shadow the embed dashboards. If anything pops, call me on mobile in addition to the page for 03:00-06:00.

lina: All set from my side. Pushing a small note to the infra-sched that midnight deploy hold is requested.

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: oncall handoff check at 23:45 UTC (15 minutes before swap).

alex (oncall): Appreciate you all taking this. I'll DM the emergency contact list to both of you in case the fallback phones need to be used. :thumbsup:

maria: confirmed — calendar updated and note added to #incidents. Good luck and safe travels, alex.

jon: Thanks, see you on the flip side.

last action: alex (oncall) set status -> "traveling, oncall swap arranged"
